claim.quote: We estimate an overall background of 0.72 cpd/kg/keV$_{ee}$ in the energy range 1$-$6 keV$_{ee}$ primarily due to radioactive contamination in the crystals.

name: Simulation and background characterisation of the SABRE South experiment
notes: A design projection (result_type technology_milestone), not a measured result.

summary.plain: A detailed simulation of the planned SABRE South detector predicts a background of 0.72 counts/day/kg/keV in the 1-6 keV region and says 2.5 years of data would test DAMA/LIBRA's signal at 4 to 5 sigma. It is a projection, not a measurement.
summary.technical: Geant4 simulation of SABRE South (50 kg target): 0.72 cpd/kg/keVee in 1-6 keVee, mostly from crystal contamination; DAMA/LIBRA-like modulation excluded (confirmed) at 4 (5) sigma within 2.5 years (Eur. Phys. J. C 83, 2023). A design projection, not a measured background.

title: Simulation and background characterisation of the SABRE South experiment
why_it_matters: The background figure fixes the physics reach quoted for SABRE South in the technical design report.
